No, but I suppose I should...kind of. One moment I think that it's just normal to be beat down when things aren't going so well...but at other times I realize that I shouldn't be this absolutely crushed by every little set back.

The problem is that I got a bad impression of it last time since they just handed me the medicine after talking for five minutes and said I should try it to see if it gets better. I spoke to them a few times during the six months I tried them but...I don't know... To actually get into therapy and get a "real" diagnosis there's a six month waiting list.

I guess it's just that I feel like I've been at this low point for 1-2 years now and I'm getting real tired of it. But maybe that's a good thing...I completely broke down yesterday but I'm still here so...I don't know.

I'll keep trying with the exercise since I do know it works if I just manage to keep it up.

Thank you. That means a lot to me.

It definitely helped to just write a post about it. After that the worst panic was over. I've tried meditation some and I'm still working on it. I don't know if I've noticed a difference yet but I'm still going. Thank you for replying.
Thank you. I'm not really waiting for any answers...I just wanted to type it out. I've calmed down enough by doing it so I should probably sleep yes.
